method: Native app accessibility and screenshot observations with synthesized keyboard events, authored Beginner automatic driving replay, temporary saves and muted output.

observations.result: Yellow TIMER FROZEN indicator appeared. Subsequent race screenshots showed countdown at 60 while original lap elapsed time advanced from 0.00 to 23.40 and the car continued driving.
Timer indicator disappeared; ordinary countdown handling restored (exact next-step decrement separately verified in timer-acceptance.json).
Accessibility showed Paused and Return/Create/Options hint; resume removed the visible overlay and racing continued.

Frame cleared and timer indicator disappeared. Final telemetry recorded 2672 post-reset frames, timer off and fault 0 on the dedicated worker thread. The independent host-reset check verifies the corresponding cold-reset path through 3000 restarted frames.

scope: Observed keyboard routing, presentation and pause/resume/reset lifecycle in the final packaged executable. This concurrent qualification run had 2 audio underruns, 0 discarded clock gaps and 0 backlog recoveries; it is not the isolated cadence/audio acceptance. Physical PS5 actuation was not tested.
